When the suspect food is known, an elimination diet that omits 
that food can be tried without the food challenge. For IgE-
mediated allergies, elimination of the food should result in im-
provement within one to two weeks. If the reaction continues
to occur, the eliminated food can be added back, but further 
testing is necessary to conﬁ rm the suspect food.35
